name: Jelevision Extras Enricher
description: Identifies anonymous local movie extras with TheDiscDb and verified feeds; correctly classifies trailers and reversibly suppresses technical reels or exact duplicates without deleting media.
overview: Name and classify local trailers and bonus features

versions.changelog: Adds conservative exact-duplicate suppression while preserving files with alternate audio, commentary, subtitle, or branching layouts.
Introduces the hybrid catalog model: public format and seed, optional authenticated production feeds, local-only matching, and unchanged offline fallback behavior.

Initial public release with privacy-preserving local catalog matching, TheDiscDb integration, technical-reel suppression, Preview/Apply/Undo tasks, provenance validation, and bundled offline fallback.
